description: All 24 Las Vegas distinctions in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest, as listed by the Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (S01). Category and cuisine/area are from S01 unless noted. Blank cells are unverified and must not be filled in.

rows.name: Joël Robuchon
rows.address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd (MGM Grand property address, S05)
rows.hours: Tue-Sat 5:00-9:30 PM. Sun and Mon closed.
rows.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 CLOSED | Tue 16 open 5:00-9:30 PM | Wed 17 open 5:00-9:30 PM | Thu 18 open 5:00-9:30 PM
rows.exceptions: Closed Mondays and Sundays. Business formal dress code. Children under 6 not included in reservations.
rows.reservations: 702.891.7925; MGM Rewards Gold+ members get priority online booking

rows.name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
rows.address: 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd (MGM Grand property address, S05)
rows.hours: Mon 5:00-9:30 PM. Tue-Wed closed. Thu-Sun 5:00-9:30 PM.
rows.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 open 5:00-9:30 PM | Tue 16 CLOSED | Wed 17 CLOSED | Thu 18 open 5:00-9:30 PM
rows.exceptions: Day pattern is unusual (open Monday, closed Tue-Wed). Flagged for manual check. Large parties: 7 or more via Large Party Specialists.

rows.name: Restaurant Guy Savoy
rows.exceptions: Official page shows 'Opens 5:00 PM' without a full weekly schedule. Hours unverified. Groups of 13+ call or submit inquiry.

rows.name: é by José Andrés
rows.property: The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas (inside Jaleo)
rows.hours: Tue-Sat 5:30-8:30 PM. Sun and Mon closed.
rows.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 CLOSED | Tue 16 open 5:30-8:30 PM | Wed 17 open 5:30-8:30 PM | Thu 18 open 5:30-8:30 PM
rows.exceptions: Only two seatings nightly. Online reservations open up to three months in advance (S06). Upscale dress code.

rows.name: China Poblano
rows.address: 3708 S Las Vegas Blvd (Michelin list in S03)

rows.name: Kabuto Edomae Sushi
rows.address: 5040 Spring Mountain Rd, Las Vegas (per official Instagram caption, S08)
rows.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 open 5:30-9:00 PM | Tue 16 open | Wed 17 open | Thu 18 open (daily hours)
rows.exceptions: Reservation only. Official post notes that when no schedule is available on a date, the restaurant may be closed. Check the reservation page before travel.

social.platform: Instagram (post linked from official site; account handle not verified)

rows.name: Lamaii
rows.address: 4480 Spring Mountain Rd #700, Las Vegas 89102 (Chinatown room, S09); 2645 St. Rose Pkwy #150, Henderson 89052 (S09)
rows.exceptions: Official site says 'Michelin Guide Selected 2026'. CVA lists it as Recommended. Both are the same tier (Recommended).

rows.name: Estiatorio Milos
rows.exceptions: Las Vegas Magazine (S23) lists it as a Bib Gourmand. This conflicts with S01 and S03. Flagged.

rows.name: Mott 32
rows.property: The Venetian / The Palazzo (S01 lists 'at The Palazzo')
rows.exceptions: Property conflict: S01 lists it at The Palazzo, but its website link is on the Venetian dining site. Flagged.

rows.name: Partage
rows.exceptions: Tasting menus of 5, 7 or 9 courses. Cannot accommodate dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, celiac, onion or garlic-free diets (S13). 12-seat private room.

rows.name: SoulBelly BBQ (Main Street location only)
rows.address: 1327 S Main St, Las Vegas, NV 89104
rows.hours: Tue-Thu 11 AM-9 PM. Fri-Sat 11 AM-10 PM. Sun 11 AM-9 PM. Monday not listed on official site (site says 'Open Tue-Sun').
rows.open_feb_15_18_2027: Mon 15 not listed (unverified) | Tue 16 open 11 AM-9 PM | Wed 17 open 11 AM-9 PM | Thu 18 open 11 AM-9 PM
rows.exceptions: Live music Friday and Saturday 6-9 PM. Reverse happy hour Fri-Sat 9-10 PM. Michelin recognition applies to the Main Street location only.

social.platform: Instagram (official account, linked from official site)

rows.name: Sparrow + Wolf
rows.exceptions: Credit card required to hold reservations. $25 per guest charge for cancellations inside 24 hours. Maximum 4 guests per table online (S14). Official site shows stale 2025 event content.

rows.name: Wing Lei
rows.exceptions: Historical note: Wing Lei held a Michelin star in the earlier 2008-09 Las Vegas guide. In the 2026 guide it is Recommended (S22). Eater's intro wording is ambiguous; flagged.
